en: The image shows an old two-story building with a gabled roof and many windows, likely made of stone or brick. The setting is a broad street or square with some trees and another building visible in the background. The postcard has a sepia tone, suggesting it is historical. Printed in red is the text identifying the location and name of the building. There are also attribution and cataloging marks along the lower edge.
